<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
I'll change the QMessageBox QPushButton color back to #FFFFFF.

All QPushButton colors in Figma should be changed back to #FFFFFF. The dialog OK buttons use figmaBlueSmall styling, which may inherit from the main window's stylesheet.
